name: Chris Leben

tenures.source: PWE's own front-page news of 1 May 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-05-01.html)
tenures.note: Named The Proving Grounds Superstar of the week on PWE's own front page of 1 May 2005: “Chris Leben was able to make the former PWE World Champ, Kurt Angle, tap out in a submission match!” The show it happened on is not identified.

portrays.note: Billed under the real mixed martial artist's own name and staged winning by submission, which is the discipline he was known for on national television that same year.

caption: Made a former PWE World Champion tap out and was named the farm league's superstar of the week for it, in a news line that never says which show it happened on.

name: Montel Vontavious Porter

tenures.source: the board's own last capture, 27 May 2007 (held in the workshop, not served)
tenures.note: The board's own results panel on its last surviving capture carries “TPG Showcase: Pride Title: Montel Vontavious Porter © d. The Mask” among the results of PWE's Trials 'N' Tribulations 2007.

portrays.note: Billed under the real wrestler's own full ring name, of which the existing external-figures row carries the initials the other registered portrayal uses; one shared node, per the real-wrestler portrayal rule.

caption: Carried the Pride Title into a TPG Showcase match on somebody else's supercard and walked out with it still on his shoulder, in the last line the record ever writes about the belt.

identity.note: Another portrayal of the same real wrestler is registered under the initials. Per the per-promotion portrayal rule, a real wrestler's character row is always a per-promotion row and is never merged across promotions; the external-figures record is the only shared node. Distinct, not the same character row.
